Innorack Tall IVC Rat

A highly controlled clean environment at each cage level Contact Sales

Innorack Tall IVC Rat Features

  • Dynamic Digital Controller
  • • Dynamically maintains settings on both supply and exhaust blowers.
  • • Quick-look color display for easy status monitoring.
  • Ergonomic Design
  • • Lightweight rack & blowers.
  • • Full cage visibility.
  • Easy Cleaning and Maintenance
  • • Continuous shelf design and smooth beveled surface allow for easy cleaning.
  • • Quick-disconnect blowers.
  • • Autoclavable Innorack available upon request.
  • Low-Vibration Rack Operations
  • • A low-vibration ventilation system creates a stress-free animal environment, contributing to animal welfare.
